Name: Grandchild's Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Replaces the default farm.
You can change the map it replaces by editing the content.json via notepad. 

Features:

• Large designated areas for all your farming needs 
(you can reach the additional area by following the lower path to the right, the upper path leads to the bus stop)

• Some free space to decorate

• (Almost) Everything is tillable

Important:
I recommend not moving the greenhouse from it's designated spot and you'll have to move the shipping bin via Robin.
